item.content: {"url": "https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=theoretical+frameworks+for+autonomous+objective+discovery+in+reinforcement+learning+agents&format=json&resultType=core&pageSize=4", "scope": "Europe PMC search metadata, abstracts and full-text links; discovery only", "excerpt": "[{\"title\": \"An Integrated Artificial Intelligence Framework for Nanomedicine Engineering.\", \"abstract\": \"The translation of nanomedicines is frequently bottlenecked by trial-and-error optimization. Integrating artificial intelligence (AI) transforms this process into a closed-loop, experimentally grounded discovery ecosystem. This Review provides a roadmap for this paradigm, demonstrating how AI, high-throughput testing, and nanoscale design converge to generate clinically translatable nanotherapeutics. We emphasize the necessity of standardized multimodal data-spanning pharmacokinetic, biodistribution, and drug-release profiles-anchored strictly to validated biological phenomena. Furthermore, we evaluate an algorithmic spectrum, ranging from classical machine learning to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) and reinforcement learning (RL), to align models with specific formulation objectives. To bridge computational design and empirical reality, we examine how high-throughput technologies, such as robotic laboratories and in vivo DNA-barcoding multiplexing, operationalize the \\\"Design-Make-Test-Analyze\\\" (DMTA) cycle for dynamic model recalibration. Ultimately, this review demonstrates how integrating AI, physical constraints, and automated validation accelerates the rational design of next-generation nanomedicines.\", \"doi\": \"10.1002/advs.78125\", \"pmid\": \"42934944\", \"pmcid\": \"PMC13710834\", \"source\": \"MED\", \"fullTextUrlList\": {\"fullTextUrl\": [{\"availability\": \"Subscription required\", \"availabilityCode\": \"S\", \"documentStyle\": \"doi\", \"site\": \"DOI\", \"url\": \"https://doi.org/10.1002/advs.78125\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \"OA\", \"documentStyle\": \"html\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13710834\"}, {\"availability\": \"Open access\", \"availabilityCode\": \"OA\", \"documentStyle\": \"pdf\", \"site\": \"Europe_PMC\", \"url\": \"https://europepmc.org/articles/PMC13710834?pdf=render\"}]}}, {\"title\": \"The rise of agentic AI in drug discover…
